images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Quiet narrative art game screenshot, flat side-on camera into a small Korean apartment bedroom at 2:47 a.m. An elderly mother with silver hair sleeps in profile on a wooden single bed under a rust-orange quilt that gently rises with her breath. A warm fabric-shaded bedside lamp throws a soft golden pool over the wall, a pill organizer and a glass of water; a wall calendar with one circled date, a framed family photo, a window with a dark night city and moon. On the right, the player sits in a teal armchair as a dark silhouette with a blanket on their lap. Hand-painted gouache look with wobbly brush edges, paper grain, muted umber and ochre palette, deep vignette. Along the bottom a single hand-drawn cream ink line traces the mother's slow, even breathing. Minimal serif UI: large clock '02:47', title '간병', soft buttons '귀 기울이기', '다가가기'. Tender, still, intimate.

images.screen: B · 05:12 — 숨의 리듬이 바뀌고 곁으로 다가가 손을 잡는 순간
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Narrative art game screenshot of an emotional beat at dawn, 5:12 a.m. Same small bedroom, camera closer to the bed; cold blue-grey dawn light pours from a large window over rooftops, the lamp now off. The elderly mother lies in profile with her mouth slightly open, breathing shallowly. The caregiver has left the armchair (pushed back, empty, at the edge of frame) and kneels at the bedside, leaning in, reaching across the quilt to hold her hand; a faint warm glow blooms exactly where the two hands meet, the only warm light in the scene. Hand-painted gouache texture, wobbly edges, paper grain, desaturated slate-teal palette with one warm accent. Bottom: a cream ink breath line that swells, fades to a flat pause, then rises again. Serif UI: clock '05:12', whispered caption '숨이 바뀌었다', a softly glowing button '손을 잡는다'. Quiet, aching, hopeful. The mother's own wrinkled, thin hand is clearly visible resting outside the quilt, and the caregiver's two hands visibly wrap around it; the glow sits exactly on the joined hands of two different people.
